grades.quote: RISC-V contains two types of atomics: AMOs and LR/SC pairs.
grades.reason: RISC-V passage that discusses AMOs conceptually (atomic, performed directly in memory) and contrasts them with LR/SC. It never names AMOADD or says an AMO adds and returns the old value, so it gives only limited background.
This passage covers xv6 sbrk and page-fault handling. It says nothing about atomic memory add instructions.
The passage describes LoongArch AMADD/AMSWAP instructions. The query requires a RISC-V instruction, so this is the wrong ISA.
